'bauhaus_werkstatt' im Bauhaus Archiv (j.summary: Workshop for all ages inspired by the collection and historic Bauhaus teaching: photography, drawing, material, pattern, colour. Registration required.

Offene Schach-Gruppe in der Humboldt-Bib.title: Open Chess Group at the Humboldt-Bibliothek
Offene Schach-Gruppe in der Humboldt-Bib.summary: New chess group at the Humboldt-Bibliothek for anyone interested, of any age. Just drop in, no registration needed.

Flohmarkt auf dem Leopoldplatz.title: Flea Market on Leopoldplatz
Flohmarkt auf dem Leopoldplatz.summary: Weekly flea market in front of the historic Schinkel church, under a new operator since 2026: vintage, books, clothes, rarities, street food and some culture.

Genter Wochenmarkt.title: Genter Straße Weekly Market (Wedding)
Genter Wochenmarkt.summary: One of Berlin's oldest markets, running 80+ years behind Rathaus Wedding: fruit and veg, bread, cheese, deli food, bags, leather goods and everyday items.

Flinta*-Schreibgruppe | Flinta* Writing.title: Flinta* Writing Group
Flinta*-Schreibgruppe | Flinta* Writing.summary: Bilingual 'Shut Up and Write' group for FLINTA* writers: say what you'll work on, write quietly for about 90 minutes, then a short wrap-up. No feedback rounds.

Schreibwerkstatt für Jugendliche in der.title: Writing Workshop for Teens at the Mark Twain Library
Schreibwerkstatt für Jugendliche in der.summary: Monthly creative-writing workshop for students 12+ in Marzahn-Hellersdorf's central library: exercises, feedback, tips and chances to read your texts in public.

Erzählzeit mit dem Kamishibai (10 & 11 U.title: Storytime with Kamishibai
Erzählzeit mit dem Kamishibai (10 & 11 U.summary: Stories told with large picture cards in a kamishibai, a traditional Japanese storytelling theatre, at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek. For ages 3+ and families.

Mitmachen: DnD Pen-&-Paper.title: Join In: Dungeons & Dragons Pen-and-Paper Role-Play
Mitmachen: DnD Pen-&-Paper.summary: Pen-and-paper role-playing game Dungeons & Dragons for ages 12–21, led in turns by Mia, Matej and Eric; no experience needed. Registration required.

FreeTour (in English).title: Exhibition Tour in English at PalaisPopulaire
FreeTour (in English).summary: One-hour guided tour of the current exhibition at PalaisPopulaire, covering its background, concepts and content, and its highlights.

Mitternachts-Stummfilm + Live-Orgel im B.title: Midnight Silent Film with Live Organ at Babylon
Mitternachts-Stummfilm + Live-Orgel im B.summary: Silent films from 100 years ago with live cinema-organ music by Anna Vavilkina at Babylon, Berlin's only silent film cinema. Book only if you will go.

Outdoor-Action At-Tabiea.title: Outdoor Action At-Tabiea for Ages 9–18
Outdoor-Action At-Tabiea.summary: Outdoor adventures by Tik e.V. for 9–18-year-olds with a BVG monthly ticket: tipi building, archery, riding, raft building and more. Registration required.

Öffentliche Führung Dokumentationszentru.title: Public Tour: Nazi Forced Labour Documentation Centre
Öffentliche Führung Dokumentationszentru.summary: Tour of a former Nazi forced labour camp: who the 13 million forced labourers were, how they were treated, plus the restored Barrack 13. No registration.

parkrun in Berlin - Volkspark Hasenheide.title: parkrun in Volkspark Hasenheide
parkrun in Berlin - Volkspark Hasenheide.summary: Weekly community run in Hasenheide park: walk, jog, run or volunteer; speed and clothing don't matter. Bring your parkrun barcode. Registration required.

NoonSong und Markt am Hohenzollernplatz.title: NoonSong and Market at Hohenzollernplatz
NoonSong und Markt am Hohenzollernplatz.summary: Short sung liturgy by professional vocal ensemble sirventes berlin, led by Stefan Schuck, at the church Am Hohenzollernplatz; a weekly market runs outside.

Comedy & Cocktails: Standup-Comedy-Show.title: Comedy & Cocktails: Stand-Up Show with Pro Comedians and Newcomers
Comedy & Cocktails: Standup-Comedy-Show.summary: A stand-up comedy show with professional comedians and newcomers at Wühlischstr. 43.

Sip Happens! Saturday Social.title: Sip Happens! Saturday Social
Sip Happens! Saturday Social.summary: Social meetup to meet new people at a Berlin bar. The bar changes each week, so check the group's Meetup or Telegram page for the venue.

Art War.title: Art War
Art War.summary: Marco Wilms' documentary about young Egyptian artists and musicians who used graffiti, street art and music as protest after the fall of Mubarak.

J. S. Bach: „Orgelmesse“ – Geistliches K.title: J. S. Bach: „Orgelmesse“ – Sacred Concert for Reformation Day
J. S. Bach: „Orgelmesse“ – Geistliches K.summary: Kilian Nauhaus's farewell concert as senior organist at St. Marien, with the MarienBachensemble led by Marie-Louise Schneider and Bishop Christian Stäblein.

Ausstellung: Maria Kaisto - Foliage (Gal.title: Exhibition: Maria Kaisto – Foliage (Galerie Pleiku)
Ausstellung: Maria Kaisto - Foliage (Gal.summary: Oil paintings by Finnish artist Maria Kaisto from Turku: expressive figurative works whose colours draw on classic Japanese textile colour schemes.

B Cell City.title: "B Cell City": Multimedia Video Art Installation
B Cell City.summary: CAM Art Co., New York, shows excerpts of "B Cell City", an immersive video art installation on life and cancer, with shout-poetry, sound and live acts.

English Comedy in an Art Gallery (Mitte).title: English Comedy in an Art Gallery (Mitte)
English Comedy in an Art Gallery (Mitte).summary: Solo English stand-up show by Prateek Jajoo (Jazz Comedy) in a cosy Mitte gallery, combined with a comedy game show involving the audience.

Kurdischer Tanz.title: Kurdish Dance with GovendaKÎ
Kurdischer Tanz.summary: Open dance group GovendaKÎ teaches dances from Kurdistan's regions and their meaning, for beginners and advanced, young and old. Bring trainers.

Frankenstein! Ein Fest zu Haloween.title: Frankenstein! A Halloween Celebration
Frankenstein! Ein Fest zu Haloween.summary: Halloween night with drinks, dancing and live music, plus a staged reading of Mary Shelley's 'Frankenstein' with actors. Come and go as you like.

Feuerwerk bei Eröffnung Winterzauber Win.title: Fireworks at Winterzauber Christmas Funfair Opening
Feuerwerk bei Eröffnung Winterzauber Win.summary: Winterzauber, the Christmas funfair with rides and food stalls once held at Alexa, now on Landsberger Allee in Lichtenberg, opens with fireworks.

Comedy & Party Night: Profi-Comedians &.title: Comedy & Party Night: Pro Comedians, Newcomers, then DJs on 3 Floors
Comedy & Party Night: Profi-Comedians &.summary: Stand-up comedy by pros and newcomers, followed by DJs on three floors.

ADIRA: Anthony Hüseyin.title: ADIRA presents Anthony Hüseyin at HANE Salon
ADIRA: Anthony Hüseyin.summary: Live performance by artist Anthony Hüseyin, hosted by the queer Arab/SWANA party ADIRA, plus a behind-the-scenes look at the ADIRA Drag Festival.

Flohmarkt S-Bhf. Friedrichshagen.title: Flea market at Friedrichshagen S-Bahn station
Flohmarkt S-Bhf. Friedrichshagen.summary: Flea market with 60 to 100 traders on a leafy car park inside the tram loop right next to Friedrichshagen S-Bahn station.

Hike through the idyllic landscape of Mä.title: Hike through the Märkische Schweiz landscape (Buckow), 17 km
Hike through the idyllic landscape of Mä.summary: Meetup group hike of 17 km through the Märkische Schweiz landscape near Buckow.

Französisch Buchholz (Berlin).title: Clothes Swap and Repair in Französisch Buchholz
Französisch Buchholz (Berlin).summary: Clothes swap for all ages in the Protestant parish hall, where you can also mend clothes yourself or get repair tips and help.

Berlin Museum: Sonntag im Nikolaiviertel.title: Berlin Museum: Sunday in the Nikolaiviertel
Berlin Museum: Sonntag im Nikolaiviertel.summary: Action day at Ephraim-Palais and Knoblauchhaus with hands-on activities, including a creative workshop with artist Ximena Ferrer Pizarro.

Gemeinsam Singen: ein traumasensibler Kl.title: Singing together: a trauma-sensitive small choir workshop
Gemeinsam Singen: ein traumasensibler Kl.summary: Singing circle of up to 8 people in a private flat in Wedding, no singing skills needed: about joy and strength through using your voice. Registration required.

Ägypten ganz nah - folge dem Skarabäus S.title: Egypt up close: scarab Scheri's search game at the Egyptian Museum
Ägypten ganz nah - folge dem Skarabäus S.summary: Search game through the Egyptian Museum run by its friends' association: young and old follow Scheri the scarab to uncover the artworks' secrets.

Weddingmarkt: Open Air Kunst- Designmark.title: Weddingmarkt: open-air art and design market with street food
Weddingmarkt: Open Air Kunst- Designmark.summary: Open-air market on Leopoldplatz with about 100 stalls of art, crafts, design, jewellery, illustration and ceramics, plus street food and dancing.

FairSpiel - Board Games (DE+EN).title: FairSpiel Board Game Meetup (German & English)
FairSpiel - Board Games (DE+EN).summary: Queer, FLINTA* and inclusive games club FairSpiel plays mostly strategic Eurogames at Begegnungsstätte Kadiner Straße; ~50 games and snacks. Allies welcome.

Lachend durch den grauen November - Hol.title: Laughter yoga on Tempelhofer Feld to beat the November grey
Lachend durch den grauen November - Hol.summary: Outdoor laughter yoga: learn playful ways to laugh for no reason, a method by Indian doctor Madan Kataria meant as fun, fitness and resilience training.

Family Open Lab – Roboter, KI und Co.: M.title: Family Open Lab – Robots, AI and co.: humans and machines as a team
Family Open Lab – Roboter, KI und Co.: M.summary: Open workshop: program robots, test them in small missions and explore what humans and machines each do well – and your own view of AI.

Public Laughing - Lachen im Park - Welln.title: Public Laughing: laughter yoga in the park
Public Laughing - Lachen im Park - Welln.summary: Laughter yoga outdoors in any weather: playful exercises get you laughing for no reason until it turns into real, hearty laughter.

Other current events.title: Other Current Events
Other current events.summary: A heading for other current events; the listing gives no event details.

Community Basketball Tag.title: Community Basketball Day for Trans, Inter and Non-Binary Players
Community Basketball Tag.summary: Networking day by Roter Stern Berlin's FLINTA* basketball team and LSVD for trans, inter, agender and non-binary players, teams and clubs, plus an ALBA game.

Berlin-Neukölln.title: Open Café and Clothes Swap at Fincan, Neukölln
Berlin-Neukölln.summary: Clothes swap with an open café: bring clothes you no longer wear and pick new ones, or just browse. Coffee, snacks and sofas for chatting.

Naza.title: Naza
Naza.summary: Documentary by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor in which 24 anonymised Israeli soldiers and intelligence officers describe how Israel wages war in Gaza.

Tanzkurs: Brasilianischer Forró Tanz bei.title: Dance class: Brazilian Forró at the Weddingmarkt
Tanzkurs: Brasilianischer Forró Tanz bei.summary: Short intro class in Brazilian Forró dance on Leopoldplatz during the Weddingmarkt, then open dancing to Forró music. Led by Ayo Barbosa.

Jeder Acker, Jede Fabrik – Ideen für ein.title: Jeder Acker, Jede Fabrik – Ideen für eine notwendige Revolution
Jeder Acker, Jede Fabrik – Ideen für ein.summary: Documentary by Labournet TV and AngryWorkers: 1970s activists and today's workers in fields, hospitals and power plants on radically changing how we produce.

Inselkino: Herr Schmidt und Herr Friedri.title: Inselkino: Herr Schmidt und Herr Friedrich and other films
Inselkino: Herr Schmidt und Herr Friedri.summary: InselKINO series on migration and refugee stories. This film portrays two men whose love story spans West and East Berlin, before and after the Wall fell.

Appetithäppchenshow (mit Imbiss).title: Appetiser show (with snacks)
Appetithäppchenshow (mit Imbiss).summary: Taster show: short preview acts by artists performing here in the coming weeks, combined with snacks.

Quo vadis, Amerika? Die USA nach den Mid.summary: Talk and discussion with US historian Dr. Andreas Etges (LMU Munich) on the midterm elections, Trump's power, Congress and the future of US democracy.

Zitadellensonntag: Zitadelle Spandau & A.title: Citadel Sunday: Spandau Citadel and all its exhibitions
Zitadellensonntag: Zitadelle Spandau & A.summary: Open day at Spandau Citadel covering all its permanent and special exhibitions, plus special programme such as guided tours.

Volksbank Kunstforum (1. Sonntag frei).title: Volksbank Kunstforum open Sunday
Volksbank Kunstforum (1. Sonntag frei).summary: Gallery-style exhibition space near Lietzenseepark showing its own art collection from changing art-historical angles. Only when an exhibition is running.

Kindl – Zentrum für zeitgenössische Kuns.title: Kindl – Centre for Contemporary Art: open Sunday
Kindl – Zentrum für zeitgenössische Kuns.summary: Contemporary art centre in the listed former Kindl brewery in Neukölln, with solo and themed exhibitions of international art on three floors.

20:00h *Live Stand Up Comedy* im Comedy.summary: 030 Comedy presents a selection of Berlin comedians doing stand-up, hosted by Daniel Luis. Drop in, or reserve via Eventbrite as the show is popular.

18:00h *Live Stand Up Comedy* im Comedy.summary: 030 Comedy presents a selection of Berlin comedians doing stand-up, hosted by Daniel Luis. Drop in, or reserve via Eventbrite as the show is popular.

Gütermarkt.title: Gütermarkt: local hybrid market in Moabit
Gütermarkt.summary: Market mixing flea and trade stalls, a bike market, crafts exchange, repair services, food, live music, boule, workshops and upcycling.

Mitsingen/Jamsession in Spandau für alle.summary: Open sing-along at the 'Bei Wilhelm' space in Wilhelmstadt: anyone can sing or accompany on their own instrument, using a songbook shared in advance.

Der Herbst wird hygge – Workshop mit Con.summary: Upcycling craft workshop at the Hansabibliothek: sew and decorate cosy home items like cup warmers from old socks and fabric scraps. Registration required.

Critical Mass Fahrradtour.title: Critical Mass bike ride
Critical Mass Fahrradtour.summary: Cyclists meet at the Brandenburg Gate and ride through the city together – part of a worldwide movement, seen as bike tour, protest or fun ride.

Martha Markt.title: Martha Market in Wedding
Martha Markt.summary: Neighbourhood market on Martha-Ndumbe-Platz with second-hand and flea-market stalls, handmade goods, food and drink, for young and old.

in den Thälmannpark.title: Walk through Thälmannpark

Kinderflohmarkt (Tegel-Süd).title: Children's flea market (Tegel-Süd)
Kinderflohmarkt (Tegel-Süd).summary: Flea market for second-hand children's things.

Ein feste Burg - Simon Borutzki und das.summary: Recorder orchestra concert in the Auenkirche on castles, kings and knights, centred on the hymn 'Ein feste Burg' in settings by Bach, Beethoven, Verdi and more.

Die Stadt als Spielfeld.title: The city as a playing field
Die Stadt als Spielfeld.summary: Open games afternoon at the Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek run by a research centre: board and card games about city life, from street furniture to Venice.

Berlin Science Week.summary: Citywide science festival with around 300 events at over 120 venues, a festival centre at Haus der Kulturen der Welt, theme 'In Touch', and a family programme.

Flucht, Vertreibung, Versöhnung – Einbli.title: Flight, Expulsion, Reconciliation – Tour of the Documentation Centre
Flucht, Vertreibung, Versöhnung – Einbli.summary: Guided tour of the permanent exhibition on forced migration in 20th-century Europe, focusing on Germans who fled or were expelled during and after World War II.

Stand Up Comedy in Moabit — Comoday — He.title: Comoday Stand-Up Comedy at Heine Bar, Moabit
Stand Up Comedy in Moabit — Comoday — He.summary: Stand-up show where hosts Paul Langer and Marco Schmalfett present six comedians from Berlin's scene, from touring pros to newcomers testing new jokes.

(Wer kennt) Public Viewing: Besondere Ta.title: Pubs Showing the Sunday Crime Drama Tatort – Public Viewing List
(Wer kennt) Public Viewing: Besondere Ta.summary: Reader-compiled list of Berlin pubs that screen the Sunday TV crime dramas Tatort and Polizeiruf, some with guess-the-culprit games. Partly outdated.

Swinging Easy Jazz Session: SEASON 4.summary: Jazz concert and jam session with a changing line-up of musicians around jazz guitarist Iakovos Symeonidis. See their Instagram for who is playing.

Lachyoga.title: Laughter Yoga at Stadtbibliothek Lichtenberg

Taizé: Nacht der Lichter in der Genezare.summary: Evening of simple, repeated meditative Taizé chants, prayer and silence by candlelight in the Genezarethkirche in the Schillerkiez.

Standup Comedy Show - SKOA Comedy @ Knei.summary: Open-mic stand-up show with selected comedians from Berlin and guests from across Germany trying out new jokes. Seats can be reserved.

Mitmachen: Lachyoga.title: Join In: Laughter Yoga at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek
Mitmachen: Lachyoga.summary: Laughter yoga: playful laughing exercises combined with deep breathing, no jokes needed. Run with the initiative “Hauptstadt lacht”. Bring a drink.

Haus. Kunst. Mitte. (sonntags frei).title: Haus. Kunst. Mitte. – Contemporary Art Exhibitions
Haus. Kunst. Mitte. (sonntags frei).summary: Exhibition space for German and international contemporary art, showing painting, photography, sculpture, installation and media art.

Einblicke in die Sonderausstellung „Ostg.summary: Guided tour of the German-Polish photo exhibition, covering its key themes, artists and the stories and memories behind the pictures. In German and English.

Tanz dich frei!, Görlitzer Park.summary: Outdoor free-dance session led by Kunti: move to music however you like, starting gently, building energy and winding down together. No experience needed.

Funktionelles Yoga!, Görlitzer Park.summary: Gentle, joint-friendly outdoor yoga for all bodies and levels, led by Kunti, with simple poses, breathing exercises and meditation. Bring a mat and props.

Schreiberei | Workshop.summary: Creative writing group for people who have been through crises: agree on a theme, write for about 40 minutes, then read aloud if you wish.

Sunday Hangover (English comedy show).title: Sunday Hangover – English stand-up comedy show
Sunday Hangover (English comedy show).summary: Stand-up comedy in English at the bar 1977 Berlin, hosted by Moe Singleton, with five or six comedians at different stages of their careers.

Trödel am Richardplatz in Neukölln.title: Flea market at Richardplatz in Neukölln
Trödel am Richardplatz in Neukölln.summary: Volunteer-run flea market of the Bürgerstiftung Neukölln in the Villa Rixdorf courtyard, with household goods; proceeds fund local civic projects.

Lesekreis/Lesegruppe.title: Reading circle: learning German through literature
Lesekreis/Lesegruppe.summary: Book club for learning German: members discuss books published in German-speaking countries. Sometimes hybrid via Zoom.

Antikmarkt am Berliner Ostbahnhof.summary: Antiques and collectors' market with stamps, books, antiques and other fine things, along the north side of Ostbahnhof station.

Repair-Café.title: Repair Café
Repair-Café.summary: Neighbours meet to repair things together that are too good to throw away. Please register in advance by email.

Jam Session Spandau.title: Jam Session Spandau
Jam Session Spandau.summary: Open jam session: anyone who wants to sing or play along on their own instrument is welcome. A songbook for each session is available by email.

Skatspielen in Friedenau.title: Skat card game meetup in Friedenau
Skatspielen in Friedenau.summary: A group meets at wild caffé on Südwestkorso to play Skat, the German card game. Please register in advance by email.

Gedenkort SA-Gefängnis Papestraße - Öffe.title: SA Prison Papestraße Memorial – public guided tour
Gedenkort SA-Gefängnis Papestraße - Öffe.summary: Tour of a memorial in former barracks where the SA ran an early concentration camp in 1933, imprisoning and torturing opponents and Jewish people.

Informationsort Schwer­belastungs­körper.summary: Tour of the 'Schwerbelastungskörper' (heavy load-bearing body), a relic of Albert Speer's megalomaniac plans to turn Berlin into Hitler's 'world capital'.

Öffentliche Führung: Ein NS-Zwangsarbeit.title: Public tour: a Nazi forced labour camp in Berlin
Öffentliche Führung: Ein NS-Zwangsarbeit.summary: Walk around a former forced labourers' camp: who they were, who profited, how racism affected them. Includes Barrack 13 and its air-raid cellar.

After Party Comedy: Standup in English S.title: After Party Comedy: stand-up in English at The Wall
After Party Comedy: Standup in English S.summary: An hour of stand-up comedy in English by local legends, rising stars and pros at The Wall Comedy, produced and usually hosted by Anna Beros.

FreeTour (auf Deutsch).title: FreeTour of the PalaisPopulaire exhibitions (in German)
FreeTour (auf Deutsch).summary: One-hour guided tour in German through the exhibitions at PalaisPopulaire, covering background, concepts, content and highlights.

Frühstückstreff Berlin im Café im Bode-M.title: Frühstückstreff breakfast meetup at the Café im Bode-Museum
Frühstückstreff Berlin im Café im Bode-M.summary: Social breakfast meetup: the Frühstückstreff group gets together at the café in the Bode-Museum on Am Kupfergraben in Mitte.

Frühstückstreff Berlin im Restaurant im.title: Frühstückstreff breakfast meetup at the Futurium restaurant
Frühstückstreff Berlin im Restaurant im.summary: Social breakfast meetup: the Frühstückstreff group has breakfast together at the restaurant in the Futurium in Mitte.

Mit - Lesen - Teilen | Shared Reading.title: Mit – Lesen – Teilen: Shared Reading group
Mit - Lesen - Teilen | Shared Reading.summary: A literary text nobody knows beforehand is read aloud, and participants share their reactions and thoughts in a relaxed, open atmosphere.

Kizomba tanzen lernen (Einführung) - int.title: Learn Kizomba: introduction to Kizomba dancing
Kizomba tanzen lernen (Einführung) - int.summary: Taster session to try Kizomba dancing and meet new people, run by the kizombaberlin.de team. Classes are in English; German also spoken.

Skat for fun und andere Gesellschaftsspi.title: Skat for fun and other board games – open games meetup
Skat for fun und andere Gesellschaftsspi.summary: Casual games meetup at Canova in Schöneberg: Skat just for fun plus board and card games. Bring your own games; tables form on the spot.

Workshop: Beep | Wir machen elektronisch.title: Workshop: Beep – we make electronic music
Workshop: Beep | Wir machen elektronisch.summary: Beginners' workshop in the Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek foyer: try electronic instruments with sound artists, maybe join an experimental jam.

Philosophie-Party.title: Philosophy party
Philosophie-Party.summary: Philosophy discussion and party: each time there is a topic and a short opening talk, academic in approach but relaxed in atmosphere.

Jugendgottesdienst in Friedenau.title: Youth church service in Friedenau
Jugendgottesdienst in Friedenau.summary: Youth church service (JuGo) with songs, prayers and a short sermon, plus cake beforehand – a chance for young people to meet new people.

Skat jeden Sonntag in Schöneberg.summary: Skat card game group playing by Altenburg rules, without money; beginners, experienced players and guests welcome. Call Wolfgang if interested.

Lachyoga in der Amerika Gedenkbibliothek.summary: The 'Hauptstadt-lacht' initiative leads laughter yoga in the library's Sunday programme, outside in good weather, otherwise in the Salon. Drop in.

SoAGB - Sonntags in die AGB!.title: SoAGB – Sundays at the Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek
SoAGB - Sonntags in die AGB!.summary: Sunday opening of the Central and Regional Library with a changing programme to join in, listen, discuss and learn, for children and adults.

Berliner Comedy. Berliner Bier. Berliner.title: Berlin Comedy, Berlin Beer: Open Mic in Kreuzberg
Berliner Comedy. Berliner Bier. Berliner.summary: A comedy open mic night in Kreuzberg.

Der Literarische Vormittag.summary: Group that discusses a book everyone has read, with background information added to the conversation. At Bibliothek am Wasserturm. Please register by email.

Pub Quiz auf Englisch und Deutsch.title: Pub quiz in English and German
Pub Quiz auf Englisch und Deutsch.summary: Pub quiz with questions in English and German.

Vortrag und Diskussion: Eat the Rich! Di.title: Talk and discussion: Eat the Rich! Seeing the world through other eyes
Vortrag und Diskussion: Eat the Rich! Di.summary: Film scholar Matthias Grotkopp on how films from the Global South and Indigenous communities show the costs of Western lifestyles, and on global solidarity.

Schattenbilder – Papierreliefs und Scher.title: Shadow pictures – paper reliefs and paper cutting with Shahla Aghapour
Schattenbilder – Papierreliefs und Scher.summary: Art course: cut, fold and layer paper into reliefs and silhouettes. Aimed especially at people with migration experience and art lovers from the area.

Kirchenführung mit Olaf Albrecht.title: Church tour with Olaf Albrecht at St. Marienkirche
Kirchenführung mit Olaf Albrecht.summary: Tour of St. Marienkirche, Berlin's oldest active church: its building history, art by Andreas Schlüter and others, and the Berlin Dance of Death.

Spieleabend in der Bibliothek Schöneberg.title: Games night at Bibliothek Schöneberg
Spieleabend in der Bibliothek Schöneberg.summary: Come alone or with friends, bring your own games or discover new ones; each month a featured game is prepared to try out. No registration needed.

Gemeinsam Häkeln (Jeden 2. und 4. Dienst.title: Crochet together
Gemeinsam Häkeln (Jeden 2. und 4. Dienst.summary: Crochet in company or learn how: bring your own project or use the materials provided and get inspired. Ages 8 and up. At Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd.

Gemeinsam Nintendo Switch Labo basteln u.title: Build and play Nintendo Switch Labo together
Gemeinsam Nintendo Switch Labo basteln u.summary: At Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd, build cardboard creations with Nintendo Labo – robots, a fishing game or race cars – and play with them together.

Geschichten-Kiste.title: Story box: storytime for children
Geschichten-Kiste.summary: Storytime for children: sit down, listen to stories and look at lovely illustrations. No registration needed.

Spiele-Nachmittag für Erwachsene.title: Games afternoon for adults
Spiele-Nachmittag für Erwachsene.summary: Games afternoon for adults in the event room of the Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek: just drop in and play. No registration needed.

Dumpling Dienstag im Café RuDi (jeden 3..title: Dumpling Tuesday at Café RuDi
Dumpling Dienstag im Café RuDi (jeden 3..summary: Cook and eat together: each time the group works its way through a different kind of dumpling from around the world. Open to all.

Häkelclub \"Jung und Alt\" (jeden 1. & 3.title: Crochet club 'Young and Old'
Häkelclub \"Jung und Alt\" (jeden 1. & 3.summary: Two young people from Sonay soziales Leben e.V. invite you to crochet together; everyone from beginners to experts is welcome.

Zocknachmittag in der Pop-Up-Else.title: Gaming afternoon at the Pop-Up-Else
Zocknachmittag in der Pop-Up-Else.summary: Try out games together outside the Pop-Up-Else, from Dash robots to PlayStation 5 – for everyone who enjoys gaming, families included. No registration needed.

Lesetraining | Für Fortgeschrittene.title: Reading practice for advanced young readers
Lesetraining | Für Fortgeschrittene.summary: 20-minute one-to-one sessions with reading mentors to practise reading and understand texts better, for ages 9+ (grades 4–7). Registration required.

Lesetraining | Für Anfänger.title: Reading practice for beginners
Lesetraining | Für Anfänger.summary: 15-minute one-to-one German reading practice with reading mentors for children from 6 who find reading hard; a reward after five visits. Registration required.

Berlin Basics | Führung durch die Berlin.title: Berlin Basics: tour of the Berlin collections
Berlin Basics | Führung durch die Berlin.summary: Tour of the ZLB's Berlin collections, with an intro to Berlin daily papers on microfilm and to using 300 years of Berlin press articles online. Not step-free.

Open Maggie - Gemeinschaftsgarten.title: Open Maggie – community garden and neighbourhood space
Open Maggie - Gemeinschaftsgarten.summary: Open neighbourhood afternoon at Maggie, Frankfurter Allee 205: coffee, games, table tennis, table football, a book and clothes swap, and a garden in the making.

Bündnis Marienfelder Allee.title: Bündnis Marienfelder Allee: Street Safety Alliance Meeting
Bündnis Marienfelder Allee.summary: Meeting of local initiatives and residents campaigning for safer streets, especially for people on foot and by bike. Building reachable by stairs only.

Gesprächs- und Literaturcafé.title: Conversation and Literature Café
Gesprächs- und Literaturcafé.summary: A book is presented, then the group talks about its themes – no need to have read it. Anyone can present a book by signing up in advance.

Leseabend von textcollective.title: textcollective Reading Night: Share Your Own Writing
Leseabend von textcollective.summary: Open evening where people read their own short stories, poems, essays or novel extracts and get constructive feedback. Listeners welcome too.

architektonische Landschaftsbilder aus M.title: Make Landscape Pictures from Moss and Wood Scraps
architektonische Landschaftsbilder aus M.summary: Craft session by FVAJ e.V. in the Schiller-Bibliothek makerspace: make small moss landscape pictures to keep. Materials provided; bring a frame (max 40×30 cm).

Solicafé Limon.title: Solicafé Limon: Neighbourhood Solidarity Café
Solicafé Limon.summary: Drop-in café for chatting, with drinks, cake, soup and snacks for whatever you can give. Rack of donated clothes to browse. Children welcome.

Gemeinsam statt allein - Digitales verst.title: Together, Not Alone: Help with Smartphones and the Internet
Gemeinsam statt allein - Digitales verst.summary: Two teenage 'digital coaches' answer your questions about the internet and help with smartphone problems. Just drop in.

Erzählspaziergang für Menschen 55+.title: Storytelling Walk for People 55+
Erzählspaziergang für Menschen 55+.summary: Teenagers and older people walk together, swap stories and get to know each other, then turn the stories into something creative, like a podcast or video.

Sport im Park: Inlineskaten und Skaterho.title: Sport im Park: Inline Skating and Skater Hockey for Families
Sport im Park: Inlineskaten und Skaterho.summary: Trainers from Spreewölfe Berlin e.V. teach inline skating (braking, safe falling, turning), followed by a skater hockey game. For families, ages about 5 and up.

Spaßiges Sprachcafé - Deutsch lernen mit.title: Fun Language Café: Learn German with Young and Old
Spaßiges Sprachcafé - Deutsch lernen mit.summary: Teenagers help you practise German in a playful way, with games, snacks and drinks, at the Kiezklub 'Haus der Begegnung'.

Ganzkörpertraining, Wiesenpark.title: Full-Body Workout, Wiesenpark
Ganzkörpertraining, Wiesenpark.summary: Outdoor full-body workout for all, with endurance and strength exercises, led by Janina. Meet at JFE Anna Landsberger, Prötzeler Ring 13.

Qigong und Tai Chi, Weichselplatz.title: Qigong and Tai Chi, Weichselplatz
Qigong und Tai Chi, Weichselplatz.summary: Traditional Chinese practice of gentle movement, conscious breathing and meditation, led by Diego. No experience needed. Meet on the lawn behind the playground.

Ballspiele und Bewegung, Warnitzer Bogen.title: Ball Games and Exercise, Warnitzer Bogen
Ballspiele und Bewegung, Warnitzer Bogen.summary: Outdoor games, table tennis, ball games and boccia, led by Ilka. No experience needed. Meet at the exercise equipment by the basketball court.

Stabilität und Mobilität, Volkspark Rehb.title: Stability and Mobility Training, Volkspark Rehberge
Stabilität und Mobilität, Volkspark Rehb.summary: Outdoor exercise class with dynamic and static exercises for stability, coordination, mobility and body control, led by Jennifer.

Ganzkörpertraining, Volkspark Rehberge.title: Full-Body Workout, Volkspark Rehberge
Ganzkörpertraining, Volkspark Rehberge.summary: Outdoor workout with varied exercises to strengthen muscles and improve flexibility, led by Jennifer. Meet on the big lawn at Transvaalstraße.

Gymnastik und Spaziergang, Volkspark Has.title: Exercises and Walk, Volkspark Hasenheide
Gymnastik und Spaziergang, Volkspark Has.summary: Walking, chatting and watching nature, combined with exercises for coordination and balance, led by Andrea. Meet at the fitness trail opposite Columbiabad.

Wirbelsäulengymnastik, Viktoriapark.title: Spine Exercises, Viktoriapark
Wirbelsäulengymnastik, Viktoriapark.summary: Beginner-friendly outdoor training focused on spine mobility, plus strength, balance and stability, led by Gerhard. Bring loose clothing and a mat.

Funktionelles Training, Viktoriapark.title: Functional Training, Viktoriapark
Funktionelles Training, Viktoriapark.summary: Beginner-friendly all-round athletic training for strength, balance, stability and mobility, led by Gerhard. Bring loose clothing and a mat.

Taichi Qigong, Tempelhofer Feld.title: Tai Chi Qigong, Tempelhofer Feld
Taichi Qigong, Tempelhofer Feld.summary: Relaxed training of body and mind – calm, strength, flexibility, breathing, concentration and balance – at your own intensity, led by Aurore. Everyone welcome.

RundUmFit für Ältere, Steinbergpark, Erh.title: RundUmFit: All-Round Fitness for Older People, Steinbergpark
RundUmFit für Ältere, Steinbergpark, Erh.summary: Varied exercises for older people with resistance bands, flexible bars and body weight, sometimes Nordic walking, led by Paula. Meet at the park entrance.

Gentle Yoga, Stadtpark Steglitz.title: Gentle yoga, Stadtpark Steglitz
Gentle Yoga, Stadtpark Steglitz.summary: Mindful movement and conscious breathing without pressure, for balance and inner strength. Outdoors, taught in English and German by Carmen.

Qi Gong, Park am Gleisdreieck (West).title: Qi Gong, Park am Gleisdreieck (West)
Qi Gong, Park am Gleisdreieck (West).summary: Qi gong with gentle flowing movements to strengthen body and mind, outdoors on the Schöneberger Wiese. No experience needed; led by Urte.

Qigong, Mariannenplatz.title: Qigong, Mariannenplatz
Qigong, Mariannenplatz.summary: Exercises from qigong and tai chi to loosen up the body, outdoors on the lawn behind Bethanien. Open to all, no experience needed.

Allgemeine Bewegung mit Yoga-Elementen,.title: Gentle Exercise with Yoga Elements, Lilienthalpark
Allgemeine Bewegung mit Yoga-Elementen,.summary: Simple exercises drawn from yoga, Pilates and gymnastics for strength, coordination and relaxation, led by Heike in German and English. Bring a yoga mat.

Tischtennis , Franckepark.title: Table Tennis, Franckepark
Tischtennis , Franckepark.summary: Table tennis for beginners and intermediate players: training, practising techniques and games. Meet outside the library by Rathaus Tempelhof.

Muskelaufbau für Ältere, Engelwiese Stra.title: Strength Training for Older People, Engelwiese Stralau
Muskelaufbau für Ältere, Engelwiese Stra.summary: Simple muscle-building exercises for people in the second half of life. Meet at the Stralau outdoor workout area.

Walking, Caroline-Tübbecke-Ufer.title: Walking, Caroline-Tübbecke-Ufer
Walking, Caroline-Tübbecke-Ufer.summary: Group walk in the fresh air around the Stralau peninsula, with or without poles, led by Siegmund. No experience needed.

Walken, Bosepark.title: Walking, Bosepark
Walken, Bosepark.summary: Walking with or without poles, combined with exercises and suitable for everyone, led by Lydia. Meet in Bosepark between the two lawns.

Yoga for All, Bosepark.title: Yoga for All, Bosepark
Yoga for All, Bosepark.summary: Mindful movement and conscious breathing without pressure to perform, taught in English and German by Carmen. Meet on the lawn behind the tennis court.

Pub Quiz.title: Pub Quiz
Pub Quiz.summary: Team pub quiz with prizes for first and second place, plus a vegan food menu, mulled wine, beer and cocktails. Registration required.

Risiko Leben – zwischen Zufall, Vorsehun.title: Living with Risk: Chance, Providence and Calculation in Antiquity
Risiko Leben – zwischen Zufall, Vorsehun.summary: Lecture series by Freie Universität Berlin and Berliner Antike-Kolleg on how ancient societies dealt with risks such as disease, disaster, war and poverty.

Aquarellmalen in der Schillerhöhe.title: Watercolour Painting Group, Schillerhöhe
Aquarellmalen in der Schillerhöhe.summary: Drop-in watercolour group for adults led by Sabine and Petra, with a new theme each month. Materials provided; beginners welcome.

Come Together Junge Selbsthilfe.title: Come Together: Self-Help for Young Adults (18–35)
Come Together Junge Selbsthilfe.summary: Informal open round where young adults aged 18–35 learn how self-help groups work, what topics come up and how others cope with challenges.

Einführungen in den m3-Musikmakerspace d.title: Introduction to the m3 Music Makerspace, Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek
Einführungen in den m3-Musikmakerspace d.summary: Guided hands-on intro to the library's music makerspace, where anyone aged 10+ can make music or podcasts without own equipment, mainly using GarageBand.

Elternbrunch.title: Parents' Brunch at the Kindervilla
Elternbrunch.summary: Breakfast for parents with children aged 0–6: eat, chat, let the little ones crawl, and swap experiences on parenting, health and balancing family and work.

Offene Digitale Sprechstunde für die Gen.title: Open Digital Help Desk for People 60+, Humboldt-Bibliothek
Offene Digitale Sprechstunde für die Gen.summary: Drop-in help for people aged 60 and over with questions about their smartphone or tablet. Android help every week; Apple help on first Tuesdays only.

Offenes Stickcafé in der Philipp-Schaeff.title: Open Embroidery Café, Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek
Offenes Stickcafé in der Philipp-Schaeff.summary: Hand-embroider together in the library makerspace, e.g. to refresh old T-shirts or make gifts. Bring a project or fabric; hoops, thread and needles provided.

Technik-Hilfe im OPZ(Olof-Palme Stadttei.title: Tech Help at OPZ (Olof-Palme Stadtteilzentrum)
Technik-Hilfe im OPZ(Olof-Palme Stadttei.summary: Open drop-in help desk: learn step by step, with no prior knowledge needed, how to use your smartphone, laptop or tablet.

Zeit für mich - Bewegung und Entspannung.title: Time for Me: Movement and Relaxation for Family Carers
Zeit für mich - Bewegung und Entspannung.summary: Group for people caring for relatives: simple exercises led by a trainer, then relaxation with Qi Gong and autogenic training to ease stress.

Stricktreff für Anfänger*innen & Fortges.title: Knitting Circle for Beginners and Experienced Knitters
Stricktreff für Anfänger*innen & Fortges.summary: Monthly knitting and crochet get-together at the Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda, with help for beginners and book tips. Bring your own project.

Häkeln / Crochet.title: Crochet and Thread Crafts for Ages 14–27
Häkeln / Crochet.summary: Try embroidery, crochet and macramé together, learn from each other and start your own thread projects. For young people aged 14–27; not in school holidays.

Zeitgenössischer Tanz.title: Contemporary Dance Class for Ages 18–27
Zeitgenössischer Tanz.summary: Dance class exploring time, space and your own creativity: grounding warm-up, improvisation, short sequences and a relaxing cool-down. For ages 18–27.

Dialog in Deutsch.title: Dialog in Deutsch: Online German Conversation Group
Dialog in Deutsch.summary: Online conversation group in German run by the Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek: talk about any topic that interests you. Registration required.

Sprachcafé.title: German Language Café, Stadtteilbibliothek Karow
Sprachcafé.summary: Practise speaking German over coffee in a relaxed, friendly setting, without fear of making mistakes, and gain confidence week by week.

Sprachcafé für Frauen.title: Language Café for Women, Stadtteilbibliothek Buch
Sprachcafé für Frauen.summary: Women meet to speak German together over coffee and biscuits. Run together with the local family centre and three refugee shelters.

Yallah-Lesen.title: Yallah-Lesen: Reading Practice for Children
Yallah-Lesen.summary: Children practise reading in a calm setting, with about 15 minutes of reading time per child. Run with Bürgerstiftung Berlin; no registration needed.

E-Book-Reader Sprechstunde.title: E-Book Reader Help Desk
E-Book-Reader Sprechstunde.summary: Help with questions about the Tolino e-reader and downloading e-books from VÖBB, the Berlin public library network. Registration required.

Schnupper-Proben Streichorchester Saiten.title: Taster Rehearsals with the Saitensprung String Orchestra
Schnupper-Proben Streichorchester Saiten.summary: Try a rehearsal with Saitensprung, the amateur string orchestra (with percussion and piano) of the Schostakowitsch-Musikschule. Registration required.

Sprache, Spiel & Spaß (dienstags).title: Language, Games and Fun for Children (6–14)
Sprache, Spiel & Spaß (dienstags).summary: Play, craft and movement session for children aged 6–14, run with the 'LernBike'.

Rühmchen – die offene Lesebühne.title: Rühmchen – Open Reading Stage at Periplaneta Literaturcafé
Rühmchen – die offene Lesebühne.summary: Open-mic stage hosted by Thomas Manegold: each performer gets 7.5 minutes for stories, spoken word, poems, songs or performance. Listen or take the mic.

Vöbb-Stunde - Digitale Angebote der öffe.title: VÖBB Hour: Discover the Berlin Libraries' Digital Services
Vöbb-Stunde - Digitale Angebote der öffe.summary: Stadtteilbibliothek Halemweg shows you step by step how to use the Berlin public libraries' e-books, digital magazines, audiobooks and more. Just drop in.

Tolino-Sprechstunde - Antworten auf Frag.title: Tolino Help Desk: Answers to Your E-Reader Questions
Tolino-Sprechstunde - Antworten auf Frag.summary: Individual help at Stadtteilbibliothek Halemweg if you're new to e-books or have questions about your Tolino e-reader. Bring your device. Registration required.

LeseZeichen - Literaturstammtisch.title: LeseZeichen: Literature Discussion Group
LeseZeichen - Literaturstammtisch.summary: Book lovers meet to talk about literature, usually around a theme; bring a short contribution if you like. Also outings, literary walks and visits to readings.

Rühmchen - offene Bühne.title: Rühmchen – Open Stage at Periplaneta
Rühmchen - offene Bühne.summary: Open stage at Periplaneta Literaturcafé with up to 8 slots for your own stories, poetry, slam, stand-up and more. Performers must sign up by email first.

Spiele-Treff.title: Games Meetup
Spiele-Treff.summary: Everyone is welcome to play games together at the cosy Experimentierort. Some games are there, or bring your own; you can make tea or coffee.

Tanzinsel in der Startbahn/Genezarethkir.title: Tanzinsel: Dance Night at Startbahn/Genezarethkirche
Tanzinsel in der Startbahn/Genezarethkir.summary: Dance party in the Genezareth church with changing DJs, a bar with alcoholic and alcohol-free drinks, headphones for kids and an awareness team.

Pen Pencil Club - Für Schulanfänger und.title: Pen Pencil Club for School Starters
Pen Pencil Club - Für Schulanfänger und.summary: Craft and play exercises that train fine motor skills, preparing children aged 6+ who are starting school for writing and learning. Max 10 children.

Demenz-Sprechstunde.title: Dementia Advice Hours
Demenz-Sprechstunde.summary: Frank Schumann of DemenzLicht offers open advice for anyone directly or indirectly affected by dementia: talk, ease fears, get information. Please register.

\"Komm'se rin!\" - inklusives Nachbarsch.title: "Komm'se rin!" – Inclusive Neighbourhood Café, Alt-Hohenschönhausen
\"Komm'se rin!\" - inklusives Nachbarsch.summary: Drop-in café with coffee, tea and biscuits for chatting and meeting new people. Games, Wi-Fi and a kids' play corner; cake baking together once a month.

Beratung und Unterstützung für pflegende.title: Advice and Support for Family Carers
Beratung und Unterstützung für pflegende.summary: Office hours of Kontaktstelle PflegeEngagement Lichtenberg, which supports family carers and people needing care with talk groups, volunteer visits and advice.

Tanz Café für Menschen mit Demenz und ih.title: Dance Café for People with Dementia and Their Relatives
Tanz Café für Menschen mit Demenz und ih.summary: Dance café for people with and without dementia at Kiezspinne FAS e.V., led by a trained educator. Help getting there can be arranged. Registration required.

Leseclub für Kinder (9 - 11 Jahren) in d.title: Reading Club for Children (9–11), Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek
Leseclub für Kinder (9 - 11 Jahren) in d.summary: Volunteers present an exciting or funny book, read from it, then the children craft, draw or solve puzzles. Max 8 children. Registration required.

Kieztraining am Leo - Lauftraining.title: Kieztraining am Leo: Running Group
Kieztraining am Leo - Lauftraining.summary: 5 km social run by the 'Fit am Leo' project: warm-up jog through the neighbourhood, interval runs around Leopoldplatz, then cool-down and stretching.

offener Handarbeitstreff in der Biblioth.title: Open Needlework Meetup, Ingeborg-Bachmann-Bibliothek
offener Handarbeitstreff in der Biblioth.summary: Bring your knitting, crochet, sewing or embroidery project and work on it alongside other crafters. Open to all ages, beginners and experienced alike.

Historische Tänze.title: Historical Dances
Historische Tänze.summary: Learn social and folk dances from around the world, mostly Renaissance and Baroque, some medieval or modern. At Fabrik Osloer Straße, staircase A, 4th floor.

Sprachcafé im STZ Prenzlauer Berg.title: Language Café at STZ Prenzlauer Berg
Sprachcafé im STZ Prenzlauer Berg.summary: Meet new people in a relaxed setting and chat about different topics while using and improving your German.

Werde Handy- und Computerhelfer*in im OP.title: Volunteer as a Phone and Computer Helper at OPZ
Werde Handy- und Computerhelfer*in im OP.summary: Call for volunteers at the Olof-Palme neighbourhood centre to help people use smartphones, tablets and laptops, learning to explain technology simply.

Gemeinsam mit der Nintendo Switch spiele.title: Play Nintendo Switch Together, Humboldt-Bibliothek
Gemeinsam mit der Nintendo Switch spiele.summary: Children play Nintendo Switch games together in the children's library, supervised by library staff. No registration needed.

Bastel-Kurs dienstags bei Tik.title: Crafts Course for Children at Tik
Bastel-Kurs dienstags bei Tik.summary: Children aged 9+ make accessories and even clothes from recycled materials. Materials provided; no experience needed. Not during school holidays.

Duft-Qigong.title: Duft-Qigong (Fragrance Qigong)
Duft-Qigong.summary: Gentle Chinese exercise of 36 short sequences of swinging, turning and circling arm and hand movements, also possible seated. Registration required.

Line-Dance für Alle.title: Line Dance for Everyone
Line-Dance für Alle.summary: Line dancing for anyone who enjoys dancing, with or without experience. Registration is requested, but spontaneous visitors are welcome too.

Akademie der Künste.title: Exhibitions at the Akademie der Künste
Akademie der Künste.summary: Visit all current exhibitions of the Akademie der Künste at Hanseatenweg, and probably also at its Pariser Platz site. Offer does not apply on public holidays.

Systemisches Coaching für Angehörige erk.title: Systemic Coaching for Relatives of People with Illness
Systemisches Coaching für Angehörige erk.summary: Coaching for relatives of people with mental or chronic illness, addiction or care needs: build on your strengths and learn self-care. Registration required.

Kostenlose Digital-Sprechstunde für Mens.title: Digital Help Desk for People Over 50
Kostenlose Digital-Sprechstunde für Mens.summary: Teenage 'digital coaches' from Sonay soziales Leben e.V. answer all your questions about smartphones, tablets and the internet.

Schauspieler gesucht.title: Actors Wanted for an Improv Theatre Ensemble
Schauspieler gesucht.summary: An improv ensemble seeks actors for its shows: improvised characters, emotions, storytelling and singing. Contact them or meet them at an Impro Super Cup show.

Zirkus.title: Circus Skills for Kids
Zirkus.summary: Children aged about 8–12 try out different circus disciplines, train their physical skills and create their own circus acts and choreographies.

Analoge Fotografie / Analogue Photograph.title: Analogue Photography Darkroom for Ages 14–27 (DE/EN)
Analoge Fotografie / Analogue Photograph.summary: Open darkroom where young people, beginners or experienced, develop their own black-and-white photos with expert advice. Bring your own film and photo paper.

Trickfilmwerkstatt.title: Animation Film Workshop for Kids
Trickfilmwerkstatt.summary: Children aged about 8–12 create their own short animated films, bringing characters and scenes to life with professional software and equipment.

Bastel-Buch: Kunst aus alten Büchern.title: Book Crafts: Art from Old Books
Bastel-Buch: Kunst aus alten Büchern.summary: Crafting group turning old book pages into origami, window pictures or table decorations. Pages provided; bring scissors and glue. Ages 14+. Please register.

Bruno - der Literaturclub für Senioren.title: Bruno – Literature Club for Seniors
Bruno - der Literaturclub für Senioren.summary: Older readers choose a crime novel or other gripping book each month, read and discuss it together, and share their own experiences. Please register in advance.

Sturzprävention für Senior*innen.title: Fall Prevention Exercise for Seniors
Sturzprävention für Senior*innen.summary: Balance, strength and coordination training at the AWO meeting centre 'Sirius-Treff'. Join at your own pace, with exercises seated or standing as needed.

Beatproduktion / Beat production.title: Beat Production for Ages 8–27
Beatproduktion / Beat production.summary: Create your own beats, rhythms and soundscapes, write a song or experiment with music. Separate sessions for ages 8–13 and 14–27; not in school holidays.

offenes Atelier/Malen nach Sound.title: Open Studio: Painting to Sound, Brotfabrik
offenes Atelier/Malen nach Sound.summary: Paint pictures inspired by music and sounds in the Brotfabrik gallery, part of its inclusive sound project. For all ages; materials provided.

inklusive Soundwerkstatt.title: Inclusive Sound Workshop, Brotfabrik
inklusive Soundwerkstatt.summary: Inclusive workshop for all ages: make sound collages and create your own sounds, with recording and audio-editing equipment and software provided.

18:00 Spieletreff/Spieleabend Brettspiel.title: Brettspielbären Board Game Night, Charlottenburg
18:00 Spieletreff/Spieleabend Brettspiel.summary: Long-running games group playing mostly complex board games that take 1.5–3 hours. Small donations from regulars go towards buying new games.

Offenes Sprachcafé - zum Deutsch lernen,.title: Open Language Café: Learn and Practise German
Offenes Sprachcafé - zum Deutsch lernen,.summary: Practise German vocabulary and pronunciation, meet people and swap experiences of life in Germany at the Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek. Best for levels A1–B2.

Was ist Pen & Paper?.title: What Is Pen & Paper? Try Tabletop Role-Playing

Abenteuer in London der 1920er.title: Adventures in 1920s London: Tabletop Role-Playing Game
Abenteuer in London der 1920er.summary: Pen & paper role-playing group playing crime/horror stories in 1920s London, led by a game master, at the Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek. Registration required.

Architektur-Highlights aus Ankersteinen.title: Architecture Highlights Built from Anker Stone Blocks
Architektur-Highlights aus Ankersteinen.summary: Display in Spandau of landmarks such as the Oberbaumbrücke and the Haus des Lehrers, and even whole districts, rebuilt with Anker toy building stones.

Modern Jive Tanzkurs, Dienstags, nahe S.title: Modern Jive Dance Class near S Hermannstraße (No Partner Needed)
Modern Jive Tanzkurs, Dienstags, nahe S.summary: Beginner-friendly class in Modern Jive, an easy partner dance mixing several styles that suits almost any music. With or without a partner; English spoken.

Wir lesen vor!.title: Story Time: We Read Aloud!
Wir lesen vor!.summary: Library staff read poems and stories, new and old, exciting and funny, to children aged 4–8. Parents can listen in, browse the library or have a coffee.

Podcast-Stammtisch im podspace.title: Podcast Meetup at podspace
Podcast-Stammtisch im podspace.summary: After-work get-together for podcast fans, from beginners to veterans, hosted by the makers of Podcast Plattform in their podcasting space.

Feminismus wagen!.title: Feminismus wagen! Open Meetup of the Feministische Partei Die Frauen
Feminismus wagen!.summary: Open, informal get-together of the feminist party Die Frauen, for women only. Registration required.

SprachRaum.title: SprachRaum: Speak German Together

Kiez-Café im Interkulturellen Garten Lic.summary: Café run by the outreach project “Unterwegs in Hohenschönhausen Süd”: cake, coffee and chat with neighbours in the garden, plus games and crafts for kids.

Unterstützung und Beratung für pflegende.summary: Kontaktstelle PflegeEngagement Lichtenberg supports family carers and people needing care: talk groups, activity groups, volunteer visits and advice.

Kitchen Talk / Language Café with CHANCE.summary: A kitchen talk and language café at Chance International.

Sprach Café (Berlin).summary: Drop-in language café run by Stadtteilzentrum Steglitz for improving your German and meeting people from other cultures.

Language café KIEZKLUB Allende (Köpenick.summary: A language café at KIEZKLUB Allende in Köpenick.
